en: A monochrome, possibly early 20th-century postcard showing a large, neo-Gothic brick building with a central archway entrance. The building is flanked by trees, and the entrance is framed by a low fence. The structure has ornate architectural details, arched windows, and multiple roof gables. The text on the postcard, in red, reads 'Wittenberg.' and 'Kavalier-Kaserne.' at the top.
